validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="total" expr="0"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <assign location="total" expr="1">2</assign>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<assign>` declares more than one value source: `expr` and the child content
notes: `<assign>` takes the value it stores from exactly one of `expr` or inline child content; with both the value is ambiguous
diagnostics.help: keep one value source: remove `expr`, or remove the child content
